activity_decision.evidence: In the ORIGINAL displacement plots, all three axes (N, E, U) show a clear, continuous change in trend after day 365 compared to the blue-shaded normal prefix: N shifts from gradual decline to steeper decline; E transitions from steady decline to near-stationary or slight rebound; U changes from gentle upward trend to accelerated upward trend. These sustained directional and rate changes persist across a substantial interval of the analysis period and are not isolated spikes or offsets.
